key_concepts: Human activities can cause water, land, and air pollution.
A clean river supports plants and animals, while a dirty river is polluted.
Pollution harms plants and animals living in a river.
Plastic litter can harm garden plants.
Acid rain is rain mixed with harmful chemicals.
Acid rain can make trees unhealthy, bare, and brown.
Acid rain can make streams muddy and lifeless.
Acid rain weakens animals and makes birds silent.
Removing pollutants can help an environment recover.
Plants and animals live best in a healthy environment.
